function.name: Query
function.description: This tool will be called when the customer asks for any information regarding the menu. This includes the menu items -> given by Item Name, the availability of an item -> given by Availability (Qty), Price of an item -> given by Price and item type -> given by tags. This DOES NOT contain the necessary information for any RESERVATION related information.

knowledgeBases.name: TheMenu
knowledgeBases.description: This Knowledge Base will be used when information regarding to the menu needs to be accessed. This includes item availability, item price, item description & menu related allergen information.  Unless specifically asked for the "Category" section will not be addressed.
